universe_note: Seed screen, origin: chain-map research. Names drawn from the S2-moved links (power-equipment, grid-interconnect, energy-generation). Global by construction with data tiers printed. Fundamentals, PCS, and earnings nuggets intentionally PENDING_DATA until the first fetch cycle and screen refresh run against live data — no numbers are invented here.

pure_play.thesis_1line: Data-center power and cooling pure play; direct beneficiary of both S2 shortage pricing and the density transition.
pure_play.link_id_basis: the screen's universe_note lists only power-equipment, grid-interconnect and energy-generation, but this row's own thesis names cooling and VRT appears on the map under liquid-cooling alone. The note was incomplete; attributing to the note's three links would have been a false attribution
